name: Uncutetifying Danny
source:
Your cute best friend, Danny, is sick of being called cute, so he needs your help to make him look cool! Your advice is important to him, so he'll change his appearance based on what you say.  Will you be able to successfully turn him uncute?

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/uncutetifying-danny]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你可爱的好朋友丹尼厌倦了被称为可爱，所以他需要你的帮助让他看起来很酷！你的建议对他来说很重要，所以他会根据你的意见改变自己的外表。你能成功地让他变得不可爱吗？

[来自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/uncutetifying-danny]itch.io[/url]]
